products.name: BAC Water
products.description: Bacteriostatic water is sterile water containing 0.9% benzyl alcohol as a bacteriostatic preservative. It is a standard laboratory solvent for reconstituting lyophilized peptides, and the preservative allows a sealed vial to be accessed multiple times.
products.previous_description_claims: minor: 'single-project use' (kept facts, tightened wording)

products.name: BPC-157
products.description: BPC-157 (Body Protection Compound-157) is a synthetic 15-amino-acid peptide whose sequence is derived from a protein fragment isolated from gastric juice. It is one of the most frequently cited peptides in preclinical literature, where it is studied in cell-culture and animal models of angiogenesis and growth-factor signaling.
products.previous_description_claims: soft-tissue healing, tendon and ligament repair, gut-lining integrity; 'starting point for a new study protocol'

products.name: BPC-157 + TB-500
products.description: A co-formulated vial containing BPC-157 and TB-500, a synthetic fragment of Thymosin Beta-4. The two peptides are frequently examined side by side in preclinical models of cell migration, angiogenesis and extracellular-matrix signaling, and co-formulation provides a fixed ratio in a single vial.
resolved_flags: Old size list included 5 mg, but only 10 mg and 20 mg had prices. Imported 10 mg and 20 mg only.
products.previous_description_claims: systemic healing, flexibility, synergistic soft-tissue recovery

products.name: Cagrilintide
products.description: Cagrilintide is a long-acting, acylated analog of amylin, a pancreatic peptide hormone. It is studied as an agonist of amylin and calcitonin receptors in metabolic-signaling research, often alongside GLP-1 receptor agonists in preclinical models.
products.previous_description_claims: appetite regulation, satiety, body-weight management

products.name: CJC-1295 (No DAC) + Ipamorelin
products.description: A co-formulated vial of CJC-1295 without Drug Affinity Complex (also known as Modified GRF 1-29), a GHRH analog, and Ipamorelin, a selective ghrelin-receptor (GHS-R1a) agonist. The pairing is used in research on the GHRH and ghrelin receptor pathways that regulate pulsatile growth-hormone secretion in preclinical models.
resolved_flags: Name corrected from 'Ipomerelin' to 'Ipamorelin'. URL changed to /product/cjc-1295-no-dac-ipamorelin.
products.previous_description_claims: 'stronger, more sustained pulse of growth hormone'; 'saves preparation time'

products.name: DSIP
products.description: DSIP (Delta Sleep-Inducing Peptide) is a naturally occurring nonapeptide first described in the 1970s. It is studied in neuroendocrine research, including its interactions with hypothalamic signaling and circadian regulation in animal models.
products.previous_description_claims: deep sleep, stress response, recovery, cognitive-restorative pathways

products.name: Epithalon
products.description: Epithalon (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly), also spelled Epitalon, is a synthetic tetrapeptide modeled on epithalamin, a peptide extract of the pineal gland. It is studied in cell-culture research on telomerase activity and in models of pineal and circadian signaling.
products.previous_description_claims: cellular aging, longevity and cellular-health positioning

products.name: GHK-Cu
products.description: GHK-Cu is a copper(II) complex of the naturally occurring tripeptide glycyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine. It is studied in in-vitro fibroblast and extracellular-matrix research, including collagen and glycosaminoglycan synthesis. The copper complex gives the powder its characteristic blue color.
products.previous_description_claims: skin remodeling, wound healing, hair-follicle support, 'topical formulations'

products.name: GHRP-2
products.description: GHRP-2 (Pralmorelin) is a synthetic hexapeptide agonist of the ghrelin receptor (GHS-R1a). It is used as a reference compound in research on growth-hormone secretagogue signaling and the ghrelin pathway.
products.previous_description_claims: appetite signaling, 'metabolic effects'

products.name: GHRP-6
products.description: GHRP-6 is a synthetic hexapeptide and one of the earliest characterized growth-hormone secretagogues. It acts on the ghrelin receptor (GHS-R1a) and is used in research on secretagogue signaling and ghrelin-receptor pharmacology.
products.previous_description_claims: hunger regulation, 'pronounced effect on appetite'

products.name: GLOW
products.description: GLOW is a multi-peptide research blend containing BPC-157, TB-500 and GHK-Cu in a single vial. It is intended for preclinical studies that examine the three compounds together, such as models of cell migration and extracellular-matrix signaling.
resolved_flags: Price is $99.00. Every other price ends in .99. Please confirm.
products.previous_description_claims: tissue repair, skin quality, 'overall regeneration'

products.name: Glutathione
products.description: Glutathione (γ-L-glutamyl-L-cysteinylglycine) is an endogenous tripeptide thiol. It is widely used in research on cellular redox balance, oxidative-stress models and enzymatic conjugation pathways.
products.previous_description_claims: 'master antioxidant', detoxification, longevity

products.name: HCG
products.description: Human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) is a glycoprotein hormone composed of alpha and beta subunits that acts on the LH/hCG receptor (LHCGR). It is used in reproductive endocrinology research, including studies of gonadotropin receptor signaling and steroidogenesis in vitro.
products.previous_description_claims: testosterone, fertility, 'endogenous hormone production'

products.name: IGF-1 LR3
products.description: IGF-1 LR3 (Long R3 IGF-1) is an 83-amino-acid analog of insulin-like growth factor 1 with an arginine substitution at position 3 and a 13-amino-acid N-terminal extension, which reduces binding to IGF-binding proteins. It is widely used as a cell-culture growth-factor supplement and in research on IGF-1 receptor signaling.
products.previous_description_claims: muscle-tissue development

products.name: Ipamorelin
products.description: Ipamorelin is a synthetic pentapeptide and selective agonist of the ghrelin receptor (GHS-R1a). Its receptor selectivity makes it a common reference compound in research on growth-hormone secretagogue signaling.
products.previous_description_claims: 'beginning a protocol'

products.name: Kisspeptin
products.description: Kisspeptin is a peptide ligand of the KISS1 receptor (GPR54), encoded by the KISS1 gene. It is studied in reproductive neuroendocrinology research on hypothalamic GnRH signaling and the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis.
products.previous_description_claims: fertility, puberty, sex hormones

products.name: KLOW
products.description: KLOW is a multi-peptide research blend containing KPV, GHK-Cu, BPC-157 and TB-500 in a single vial. It is intended for preclinical studies that examine the four compounds together, including models of inflammatory signaling, cell migration and extracellular-matrix activity.
resolved_flags: Price is $109.00. Every other price ends in .99. Please confirm.
products.previous_description_claims: tissue healing, inflammation modulation, skin quality, systemic recovery

products.name: KPV
products.description: KPV (Lys-Pro-Val) is a tripeptide corresponding to the C-terminal sequence of alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (α-MSH). It is studied in cell-culture and animal models of inflammatory signaling, including NF-κB pathway activity.
resolved_flags: Old store had no size listed. Set to 10 mg from the old description and photo. Please confirm.
products.previous_description_claims: anti-inflammatory properties, gut health, tissue recovery

products.name: MOTS-c
products.description: MOTS-c is a 16-amino-acid peptide encoded within the mitochondrial 12S rRNA gene. It is studied in research on mitochondrial-nuclear signaling, AMPK activation and cellular energy metabolism.
products.previous_description_claims: insulin sensitivity, exercise capacity, metabolic health

products.name: MT-2 (Melanotan II)
products.description: Melanotan II (MT-2) is a synthetic cyclic heptapeptide analog of alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (α-MSH) and a non-selective melanocortin receptor agonist. It is used in research on melanocortin receptor signaling, including MC1R-mediated melanogenesis in vitro.
products.previous_description_claims: skin pigmentation, appetite, libido

products.name: Pinealon
products.description: Pinealon (Glu-Asp-Arg) is a synthetic tripeptide. It is studied in cell-culture and animal models of neuronal oxidative stress and gene-expression regulation.
products.previous_description_claims: neuroprotection, 'brain-supporting properties', cognition, brain health

products.name: PT-141
products.description: PT-141 (Bremelanotide) is a synthetic cyclic heptapeptide melanocortin receptor agonist and an active metabolite of Melanotan II. It is studied in research on central melanocortin (MC3R/MC4R) signaling.
products.previous_description_claims: libido, sexual response, sexual health

products.name: Retatrutide
products.description: Retatrutide is a synthetic single-molecule agonist of three receptors: GLP-1, GIP and glucagon. It is studied in metabolic-signaling research on incretin and glucagon receptor pathways.
resolved_flags: Renamed from 'GLP-3 (Rt)' to Retatrutide. URL changed to /product/retatrutide.
No sale on 5 mg (regular price = sale price), so no strikethrough is shown.
products.previous_description_claims: appetite regulation, blood-sugar control, body-weight management

products.name: Selank
products.description: Selank is a synthetic heptapeptide analog of tuftsin, an endogenous immunomodulatory peptide, extended with a Pro-Gly-Pro sequence for stability. It is studied in animal models of GABAergic signaling and brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) expression.
products.previous_description_claims: anti-anxiety, mood, stress resilience, cognitive performance

products.name: Semaglutide
products.description: Semaglutide is a synthetic, acylated analog of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and a GLP-1 receptor agonist. It is one of the most frequently studied compounds in research on incretin receptor signaling.
resolved_flags: Renamed from 'Semaglutide (GLP-1)' to Semaglutide to match Tirzepatide and Retatrutide. URL changed to /product/semaglutide.
No sale on 10 mg (regular price = sale price), so no strikethrough is shown.
products.previous_description_claims: appetite regulation, blood-sugar control, body-weight management

products.name: Semax
products.description: Semax is a synthetic heptapeptide analog of the ACTH(4-10) fragment, extended with a Pro-Gly-Pro sequence. It is studied in animal models of neurotrophic signaling, including BDNF expression.
resolved_flags: No sale on 10 mg (regular price = sale price), so no strikethrough is shown.
products.previous_description_claims: focus, memory, cognitive enhancement, neuroprotection

products.name: Snap-8
products.description: SNAP-8 (Acetyl Glutamyl Heptapeptide-3) is a synthetic octapeptide modeled on the N-terminal end of the SNAP-25 protein. It is studied in cosmetic-science and in-vitro research on SNARE complex formation.
products.previous_description_claims: smoothing expression lines, wrinkles, skincare

products.name: SS-31
products.description: SS-31 (Elamipretide) is a synthetic, cell-permeable tetrapeptide that localizes to the inner mitochondrial membrane, where it interacts with cardiolipin. It is studied in research on mitochondrial membrane structure, electron transport and reactive oxygen species.
products.previous_description_claims: 'supporting mitochondrial function', preserving energy production, mitochondrial health

products.name: TB-500
products.description: TB-500 is a synthetic peptide based on the active region of Thymosin Beta-4, an actin-sequestering protein. It is studied in preclinical research on actin dynamics, cell migration and angiogenesis.
products.previous_description_claims: tissue healing, flexibility, reducing inflammation 'across the body'

products.name: Tesamorelin
products.description: Tesamorelin is a synthetic analog of growth-hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH) comprising the 44 amino acids of human GHRH with an N-terminal trans-3-hexenoyl modification. It is studied in research on GHRH receptor signaling and the GH/IGF-1 axis.
products.previous_description_claims: reduction of visceral fat, body composition

products.name: Thymosin Alpha-1
products.description: Thymosin Alpha-1 is a 28-amino-acid acetylated peptide originally isolated from thymus tissue. It is studied in immunology research on T-cell maturation and toll-like receptor signaling.
products.previous_description_claims: supporting immune function, resilience against infection, aging

products.name: Tirzepatide
products.description: Tirzepatide is a synthetic single-molecule agonist of the GIP and GLP-1 receptors. It is studied in research on dual incretin receptor signaling.
resolved_flags: Renamed from 'Tirzepatide (GLP-2)': tirzepatide is a GIP/GLP-1 agonist, not GLP-2.
products.previous_description_claims: appetite, glucose regulation, body-weight management
